summary: Backend-only pytest of EduMaht LMS AI: 31/33 passing. All auth, AI Tutor chat/sessions/download/delete/explain/summarize/retention-notice, and all Quiz CRUD/attempts/export/role-gating flows passed end-to-end. The 2 failing tests are quiz.generate endpoints that hit Gemini free-tier daily quota (429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, 20 req/day limit on gemini-2.5-flash). The endpoint logic itself is correct (verified by chat/explain/summarize which use the exact same Gemini pipeline and all succeeded earlier in the run).

minor.issue: Returns 502 'Gagal generate quiz: litellm.RateLimitError ... code:429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, limit:20/day gemini-2.5-flash' once the daily quota is exhausted. The fallback logic in gemini_tutor._send_with_fallback only treats 503/unavailable/overload/timeout as transient; it does NOT catch 429 RateLimitError, so the declared fallback models (gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-2.5-pro) never get tried on quota errors. Recommend: extend _send_with_retry/_send_with_fallback transient detection to also include '429', 'rate limit', 'quota', 'resource_exhausted' so fallback models can absorb per-model daily quota, AND surface a friendlier 429 to clients instead of generic 502.

action_items: Improve Gemini fallback: in /app/backend/app/ai_services/gemini_tutor.py add 429/RateLimit/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED to the transient-error list in _send_with_retry (or catch in _send_with_fallback) so fallback to gemini-3-flash-preview / gemini-2.5-pro actually triggers when free-tier quota is hit on the primary model.
Consider mapping upstream 429 to HTTP 429 (with Retry-After) instead of 502 Gemini error for better UX.
Document in README/ops notes: user-supplied Gemini key is free-tier (20 req/day per model). Either upgrade billing plan or rely on fallback model spread to stay usable during heavy testing.
critical_code_review_comments: gemini_tutor.py fallback ordering is good but transient-error detection misses 429/RateLimitError — fallback to gemini-3-flash-preview / gemini-2.5-pro never fires on quota exhaustion (root cause of the 2 test failures).
quizzes.py _serialize_quiz correctly hides correct_answer/explanation from students (verified). Good separation of source='system' vs 'teacher'.
ai_tutor.py correctly enforces owner-only access on sessions/messages/download/delete (teacher returns 403 'Hanya pemilik sesi' — verified).
_cleanup_expired runs on every chat/list call and uses UTC cutoff — OK, simple and idempotent.
server.py _seed_demo_users is idempotent via email lookup — good.

Minor: chat endpoint persists user_msg before AI call; if Gemini call fails, the user message stays in DB without an assistant reply. Consider either wrapping in a transaction rolled back on failure or tagging orphaned user messages.
Minor: ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES=1440 (24h) + refresh 30d is fine; SECRET_KEY is committed in backend/.env — reminder to rotate before production deploy.
Minor: CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is semantically disallowed by spec (browsers ignore credentials); tighten in prod.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Gemini key is free-tier (20 req/day per model on gemini-2.5-flash). Running the full suite once consumes most of the quota; subsequent runs in the same 24h window will see 429 on late AI calls (chat/explain/summarize/quiz-generate). If you need to re-run AI tests, either wait for the daily window to reset, or once main agent extends fallback to catch 429 the tests should stay green because gemini-3-flash-preview / gemini-2.5-pro have separate per-model quotas.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the 2 failures: Gemini free-tier per-model-per-day quota (20 requests/day) on gemini-2.5-flash was exhausted earlier in the same test run by the chat/explain/summarize AI-Tutor tests. When quiz-generate calls fired at the tail of the run, Gemini returned 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. The backend's _send_with_retry considers only '503/unavailable/overload/timeout' as transient and re-raises on 429, so _send_with_fallback propagates the exception without ever trying gemini-3-flash-preview or gemini-2.5-pro. FastAPI handler wraps it into HTTPException(502, 'Gagal generate quiz: ...'). Reproduction: run the full pytest twice in quick succession, or run >20 AI-backed calls against gemini-2.5-flash in 24h. Mitigation: (a) add 429/RateLimit/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED/quota to transient keywords so fallback models kick in, (b) upgrade Gemini plan, or (c) cache/rate-limit AI generate calls at backend.
